authorization.scheduled: policy_id instagram.publish via policy_authorization_v1; Worker derives exact caption/content/package/media bindings and standing authorization, evaluates before acceptance and again before publish mutation; decision receipt precedes action
authorization.immediate: velvet.delivery_approval.v1 remains required for immediate direct publish_* mutations
authorization.migration: migration_authorization allowed only for the recorded 2026-09-24 OpenPost cutover
authorization.legacyCompatibility: stored pre-cutover jobs only; new jobs cannot use legacy authorization kinds

reliability.media: KV write-once/idempotent with SHA-256 verification at upload, scheduling and publish time
reliability.duplicateProtection: atomic D1 claim + HMAC-bound immutable job + 72h publish fingerprint guard
reliability.ambiguousOutcome: reconcile_required; never blind-retry after media_publish boundary or expired publishing lease
reliability.verification: published_verified only after Graph media read-back returns permalink
reliability.policyGate: LIVE: ALLOW required before job acceptance and immediately before publishJob; DENY=dead_letter; REQUIRE_OWNER_APPROVAL=waiting_approval

costPolicy.guard: stay within Free plan quotas; no paid dependency is required by this runtime

calendarMirror.role: read-only operational mirror; never source of truth
calendarMirror.verification: calendar exists; exactly one syncPublisherCalendar trigger; one scheduled event verified; reminders disabled; transparency=transparent
